assumptions: SIMULATION: every resident, helper and fire is synthetic; these numbers describe the model, not a forecast.
50 paired runs: for each seed, both policies face the same fire, population and helpers; only the policy differs.
Rates are per run (homes evacuated / homes); 95% intervals are percentile bootstrap intervals over runs (2000 resamples).
Vulnerable lift is the mean per-seed difference (Last Mile minus alerts only) in the vulnerable evacuated rate, bootstrapped over seeds so each pair stays together.
"Vulnerable" means no vehicle, or any of: no vehicle, wheelchair, oxygen, dementia, medical device, vision impaired.
